name: tuff-game
description: Top-down multiplayer zombie survival sandbox that runs in the browser.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tuff/client && npm run build -w @tuff/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && npm run ironwild:typecheck
scripts.ironwild:build: npm run build -w @ironwild/client && npm run build -w @ironwild/server
scripts.ironwild:typecheck: tsc -p ironwild/shared --noEmit && tsc -p ironwild/server --noEmit && tsc -p ironwild/client --noEmit
